text:
Marta L.: Quick flag 0: Sofia (new hire) starts next Monday 9am PT / 6pm CET and can't make an on-site I-9. Need alternate verification for Berlin-based hire.
Noah R.: Got it. Two approved paths: 1) our virtual I-9 vendor (live video + scan) or 2) local notary + courier of signed pages. Both need preboarding forms completed before EOD Day 1.
Sofia H.: I have an EU passport and a German residence permit. Will the vendor accept those? Also worried about shipping timing for the laptop.
Marta L.: For international hires, vendor accepts passport + residence permit. Courier option works too but adds 2-3 days. We'll hold the laptop until verification completes if you prefer.
Noah R.: FYI benefits enrollment email goes out immediately after account activation with a 7-day window. We can grant a 14-day exception for timezone/translation issues but it must be recorded in the HRIS note.
Sofia H.: Please apply the 14-day extension 0 — I'm getting documents translated and may need the extra time.
Marta L.: Done. Applying 14-day benefits exception and adding note to Sofia's record.
LogisticsBot: Hardware shipment paused for candidate Sofia H. pending ID verification.
Noah R.: I'll send the vendor link + preferred slots request. Sofia, please reply with 3 windows (CET) you can do. Once verification booked we'll release the laptop.
Sofia H.: Sending 3 slots in DM now 0:30-21:00, 22:00-22:30, 08:00-08:30 CET (next day). Thanks all.
OpsBot: Onboarding checklist updated: "Virtual I-9 booked (pending)".
Marta L.: Quick checklist recap (pasteable):
```
Virtual I-9 checklist:
- Bring passport + residence permit (List A) OR DL + SSN card (List B+C)
- Have translations ready (if docs not in English)
- Complete preboarding forms and upload to HRIS before EOD Day 1
- Benefits: 14-day exception applied per request
- Logistics: Hold laptop shipment until verification completed
```
Noah R.: I'll also note that if vendor video fails, fallback is local notary + next-day courier.
Sofia H.: Appreciate the flexibility 0: will confirm slot in DM.
Marta L.: Thanks team. Action items: Noah send vendor link, Logistics hold hardware, Marta log exception, Sofia reply with windows.
Noah R.: On it.
Sofia H.: Confirmed 22:00 CET slot. See you then. :thumbsup:
